关闭开关时，明细字段会隐藏，但它的值仍保留，而且不参与必填校验；开启开关时，明细字段会参与必填校验。点击按钮只会生成可编辑草稿，不会自动发送。

```kelivo-ui
ui 1 catalog "kelivo.native/1"
root = Column(children=[form,ask])
$on: boolean = false
$name: string = ""
$detail: string = "保留内容"
form = Form(children=[toggle,nameField,detailField], title="公司发票信息")
toggle = Switch(label="启用发票明细", bind=$on)
nameField = TextField(label="公司名称", bind=$name, required=true)
detailField = TextField(label="发票明细", bind=$detail, required=true, visible=$on)
ask = Button(label="生成检查草稿", form=form, action=Ask(text="请检查此表单的可编辑草稿，确认内容后再决定是否发送。", context={"name":$name,"enabled":$on,"detail":$detail}))
```
